query: WITH sale_lines AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.created_at, o.order_type, o.payment_method, i.product_id, i.unit_price, i.quantity - COALESCE(i.returned_quantity, 0) AS net_quantity FROM mysql_source.supermarket_api.sales_order_items i JOIN mysql_source.supermarket_api.sales_orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-29 17:00:00' AND o.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-29 17:00:00' AND o.order_type = 'IN_STORE' AND o.status IN ('PAID','PARTIALLY_RETURNED','RETURNED')), catalog AS (SELECT sku, MAX(name) AS name, MAX(categoryName) AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS catalog_count FROM mongo_source.supermarket_catalog.products_catalog GROUP BY sku), sales AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.sku_code AS sku, COALESCE(m.name, p.name) AS product_name, COALESCE(m.category_name, 'Chưa có catalog MongoDB') AS category_name, COALESCE(m.catalog_count, 0) AS catalog_count, SUM(l.net_quantity) AS net_quantity, SUM(l.net_quantity * l.unit_price) AS net_sales_amount FROM sale_lines l JOIN mysql_source.supermarket_api.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id LEFT JOIN catalog m ON CAST(p.sku_code AS VARCHAR) = m.sku GROUP BY p.product_id, p.sku_code, COALESCE(m.name, p.name), COALESCE(m.category_name, 'Chưa có catalog MongoDB'), m.catalog_count HAVING SUM(l.net_quantity) > 0), totals AS (SELECT SUM(net_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM sales) SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN t.total_quantity > 0 THEN 100.0 * s.net_quantity / t.total_quantity ELSE 0 END AS quantity_share_percent FROM sales s CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY net_quantity DESC, sku LIMIT 20
